contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Incompplete early-medieval Post-Reform silver penny, Edgar to Aethelred II (c793-1016), mint unknown, moneyer uncertain (SIGE...). Obverse description: Debased draped and diademed bust left, with large eye. Initial cross pattee. Obverse inscription: +ED(---)ANGL, N is retrograde. Reverse description: Small cross pattee set centrally. Reverse inscription: [ ]SIGE[ ]. Diameter: 20.2mm, Weight:…
